system.name: TEDBench
system.one_liner: Large-scale non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification from TED and AlphaFold structures with 965 CATH topology labels.

content.variant_note: a task strip and a sunburst of the label space at left, three stacked tiles of statistics and examples at right, divided by dotted lines
content.argues: TEDBench is large, non-redundant and long-tailed: 965 hierarchical CATH topology labels over 462K predicted structures, with 27K experimental structures held out.
content.subject: Protein structure inputs, the CATH label hierarchy as a sunburst, label-count and split statistics, and two example fold functions.

lessons.what_to_learn: Summarise a benchmark as a dashboard: the task at the left as inputs plus a big arrow into the label hierarchy drawn as a sunburst with the benchmark logo in its hole, then a right column of compact tiles (long-tail plot, split bar, example records) divided by dotted lines.
lessons.suits: Dataset or benchmark papers with a hierarchical label space and statistics that fit small tiles.

evidence: TEDBench is a large-scale, non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification.
Our TEDBench builds upon TED and contains more than 460K predicted structures and 27K experimental structures as an external test set.
We use a ratio of [0.8, 0.1, 0.1], preserving class proportions across splits.

summary: TEDBench is a large non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification built from TED and AlphaFold structures, with 27K experimental structures as an external test set. Figure 1 is a dashboard-style overview. At left, two red protein ribbon renders sit under 'Protein Structure Inputs' and a big black arrow labelled 'Hierarchical CATH Prediction' leads into a sunburst of the CATH label space (965 topology labels) with the TEDBench logo in its hole and a grey legend box. A dotted divider separates a right column of three tiles: a long-tail curve of samples per topology label, a stacked bar of the 462,175 AlphaFold and 27,638 experimental structures split into train, validation, test and experimental, and a table of two example folds with their functions.
summary_zh: TEDBench 是大规模非冗余蛋白折叠分类基准。图 1 为仪表盘式总览：左侧输入结构经 CATH 层级预测指向 965 个拓扑标签的旭日图，右侧三块依次是长尾分布、数据划分条和示例折叠功能。
notes: The prior listed contribution-mosaic first with variant benchmark-dashboard; benchmark-dashboard is a scope-overview variant, so scope-overview is primary here. Panel count 5 counts the two titled left units and the three tiles divided by dotted lines. Wedge size is not stated in the figure, so nothing is claimed about what wedge area encodes.
